# Wrecked Metal v0.1.2 — Baja Buggy physics fix

A bug fix release.

> **You need your own ROM.** This release contains no ROM and no game assets, exactly like the earlier betas.

## Fixed

- **The Baja Buggy no longer flies off.** The unlockable Baja Buggy (and one other unlockable car with the same off-road handling) could suddenly spin and launch at absurd speed after touching a wall or another car. The original game did not do this: a math routine in the port read the two halves of a 64-bit number in the wrong order, so those cars' rear-tyre grip came out badly wrong. It now matches the original cartridge.
- **Start boost restored for every car.** The same math bug also switched off the extra tyre force the original game gives a car for a well-timed start (revving at the right moment before the lights). It works as on the cartridge again.

## Install

Download the APK below and install it over the previous version: your settings, save and ROM are kept.

**Requirements:** Android 10+, Vulkan, and a device that can run 32-bit apps (this build is `armeabi-v7a`).

## Support

Wrecked Metal is free and will stay free. If you'd like to support the work, tips are welcome on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/costelinha_games). Entirely voluntary, and nothing is locked behind them.
